pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of multiple entries within a 5-point range; zero averaging down or adding to correlated positions during high-velocity spikes.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block validation and ATR-based volatility cap; block entries if spread exceeds 0.40 on XAUUSD or if price is within 3 pips of a major liquidity node.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing locks at +$10.00 and execute hard profit sweeps at +$15.00 to +$30.00.
